# JacksonWhite Attorneys at Law

> Full-service Arizona law firm specializing in estate planning, criminal defense, family law, and elder care with offices in Mesa, Phoenix, and surrounding areas.

JacksonWhite has provided comprehensive legal services throughout Arizona since 1983, with a particular focus on estate planning, probate, elder law (ALTCS/Medicaid), criminal defense, family law, and personal injury representation. The firm serves clients across the Phoenix metropolitan area including Mesa, Scottsdale, Peoria, Gilbert, Chandler, and Tempe.

## Key Topics

- Estate Planning
- Criminal Defense
- Family Law & Divorce
- Elder Law
- ALTCS & Medicaid Planning
- Probate & Trust Administration
- Personal Injury
- Commercial Litigation
- Labor & Employment Law

- DUI Defense
- Drug Crimes
- Small Business Law
